poll.source_locator: Toplines Poll #3 p.2-3, 'Q5R COMBINED RESULTS' (Q5 forced choice + Q5b already voted): Roy Cooper (Democrat) 54.0%, Michael Whatley (Republican) 44.9%, Shannon W. Bray (Libertarian Party) 0.8%, Michael Dublin (Green Party) 0.3%
poll.notes: other = Bray 0.8 + Dublin 0.3. Toplines note: 'All respondents were asked to choose a Senate candidate, including those who initially said they were undecided' (Q4: 4.7% still undecided), so LEANERS and no undecided row. Release https://surveyresearch-ecu.reportablenews.com/pr/ecu-poll-cooper-leads-whatley-by-9-points-as-election-day-nears dated November 1, 2026. Credibility interval +/-3.5. 56.9% said they had already voted. Missed by the 2026-11-01 sweep (not on Wikipedia's NC table). AUDIT 2026-11-02: denominator TWO_WAY (same forced-choice item as ECU's stored NC row); recall UNVERIFIED.

pollster.weighting_quote: The data were weighted to reflect the population of likely 2026 general election voters in North Carolina based on age, education level, race/ethnicity, gender, region, and party identification, as well as election modeling based on previous statewide elections in North Carolina.
pollster.method_locator: Methodology section of the release (past-election modeling, respondent recall not stated)
pollster.mode: MMS-to-web (n=508, L2 via ReconMR), landline IVR (n=236), Bovitz online panel (n=297)
